description: Database schema with Drizzle ORM, mock data layer, and tRPC routers for Documents and PL Numbers. Creates the full Drizzle schema (ready for PostgreSQL but not connected), implements a mock data service layer that mimics database operations, and builds the documents and pl tRPC routers with all CRUD operations using mock data. Includes file deduplication logic (metadata + 3-point 64kb hash).
steps: Create src/lib/db/schema/users.ts: Drizzle ORM schema for users table exactly as defined in Product Spec Section 5. Use pgTable with all columns, indexes, and constraints
Create src/lib/db/schema/pl-numbers.ts: Drizzle schema for pl_numbers table with all fields (pl_number CHAR(8), category, status, safety_critical, etc.) and the search_vector generated column

Create src/lib/db/schema/documents.ts: Drizzle schema for documents table with all fields (document_number, title, category, status, revision, file_hash, file_path, ocr_status, ocr_confidence, etc.) including partition definition
Create src/lib/db/schema/document-pl-links.ts: Many-to-many link table schema
Create src/lib/db/schema/work-records.ts: Drizzle schema for work_records with all disposal tracking fields
Create src/lib/db/schema/approvals.ts: Drizzle schema for approvals table
Create src/lib/db/schema/cases.ts: Drizzle schema for cases table
Create src/lib/db/schema/bom.ts: Drizzle schemas for bom_products and bom_entries tables
Create src/lib/db/schema/ocr-jobs.ts: Drizzle schema for ocr_jobs table
Create src/lib/db/schema/audit-log.ts: Drizzle schema for audit_log table with hash chain fields
Create src/lib/db/schema/notifications.ts: Drizzle schema for notifications table
Create src/lib/db/schema/settings.ts: Drizzle schema for settings table
Create src/lib/db/schema/index.ts: Export all schemas from a single barrel file

Create src/lib/mock-data/documents.ts: 50+ mock documents covering all categories (DRAWING, SPECIFICATION, ELIGIBILITY_CRITERIA, etc.) with realistic Indian Railways data (CLW drawing numbers, revision codes, PL linkages)

Create src/lib/mock-data/pl-numbers.ts: 30+ mock PL numbers with realistic 8-digit codes, names (Traction Motor, Armature Assembly, Bogie Frame, etc.), categories (CAT-A through CAT-D), safety classifications
Create src/lib/mock-data/index.ts: Barrel export for all mock data

Create src/server/services/mock-db.ts: In-memory mock database service that provides CRUD operations (list with pagination/filter/sort, getById, create, update, delete) against mock data arrays. Supports search with simple text matching. This is the adapter that will be swapped for real Drizzle queries later

Create src/lib/storage/deduplication.ts: File deduplication logic - compute SHA-256 hash, implement 3-point 64kb hash calculation (read 64kb from start, 64kb from middle, 64kb from end of file, hash all three). Export checkDuplicate(fileBuffer, metadata) function that returns {isDuplicate, existingDocId, hash}

Create src/lib/storage/file-service.ts: File storage service for network drive. Functions: storeFile(buffer, hash) -> stores at /storage/originals/sha256/aa/bb/<hash>, getFilePath(hash), generateThumbnailPath(docId), deleteFile(hash). Content-addressed storage pattern
Create src/lib/validators/documents.ts: Zod schemas for document operations (create, update, list filters, upload, link-pl, approve, bulk-action)
Create src/lib/validators/pl-numbers.ts: Zod schemas for PL operations (create, update, list filters, search). PL number validation: exactly 8 digits

Create src/server/routers/documents.ts: Documents tRPC router with all procedures from Product Spec Section 6: list (paginated, filterable), getById, upload (with dedup check), update, delete (soft), linkPL, unlinkPL, approve, getPreview, bulkAction. Uses mock-db service. Protected with appropriate role guards
Create src/server/routers/pl.ts: PL Numbers tRPC router: list, getById, create, update, getLinkedDocs, getLinkedWork, getLinkedCases, search. Uses mock-db service
Update src/server/routers/_app.ts to include documents and pl routers

Create drizzle.config.ts: Drizzle Kit config pointing to schema files, PostgreSQL dialect, connection string from env (DATABASE_URL). This won't connect yet but enables future 'npx drizzle-kit push' when DB is available
Verify: 'npm run build' succeeds, 'npm run lint' passes
acceptance_criteria: All Drizzle schemas compile without TypeScript errors
Mock data includes 50+ documents and 30+ PL numbers with realistic Indian Railways data
documents tRPC router provides list (paginated), getById, upload (with dedup), update, delete, linkPL, approve
pl tRPC router provides list, getById, create, update, getLinkedDocs, search
File storage service uses content-addressed paths (sha256/aa/bb/<hash>)
Zod validators enforce PL number as exactly 8 digits
verification: Run 'npm run build' and confirm exit 0
Run 'npm run lint' and confirm no errors
